## Change

Describe what changes for users or API consumers.

## Compatibility

Apply exactly one label according to [the public contract and SemVer policy](https://github.com/atlet99/cleanyourtv-WebOS/blob/main/docs/development/versioning.md):

- `semver:patch`: backward-compatible bug fix.
- `semver:minor`: backward-compatible functionality or deprecation.
- `semver:major`: incompatible public API, data or supported-upgrade change; explain migration.
- `semver:none`: no application release, e.g. tests, CI or editorial documentation.

## Verification

List the checks performed and any required on-TV verification.
